## The everyday decision

What can a household's electricity measurements reveal about when and how
energy is used?

## The evidence

The [UCI household power dataset](https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/235/individual+household+electric+power+consumption)
records one home in France at one-minute intervals from December 2006 to
November 2010. It includes missing readings and submetering, but not electricity
prices. Results about this household should not be presented as population-wide
or current bill estimates.

## Status

Published entries will identify their data cutoff, aggregation rules and exact
analysis revision.
